item: Low-memory import scratch: disk preflight, killed-merge leftover sweep, encryption pinned by test
summary: R319 release note: importing into an encrypted corpus with little free memory now checks up front that the drive has room for the import's encrypted temporary file (refused before any row moves, with the restore's own free-space message), and removes a temporary file an interrupted import left behind. Tests now read the scratch file byte for byte to prove it is encrypted.
